takes.h: Other Worlds Than These closes the Talisman trilogy
takes.p: Stephen King and Peter Straub's Other Worlds Than These, the third and final Talisman book, came out from Scribner on October 6. It runs 624 pages and carries 38 black-and-white illustrations by Gabriel Rodríguez. The audiobook is narrated by Patton Oswalt.

takes.h: Stephen Graham Jones's Off the Reservation lands October 13
takes.p: Stephen Graham Jones's Off the Reservation arrives from Saga Press in hardcover on Tuesday, October 13. Activists retrieve the bones of a Blackfeet boy who died at the Carlisle Indian Industrial School, and something dangerous comes back with them. Nate Yellow Tail, who survived The Only Good Indians, is the protagonist.

Universal's The Exorcist: Martyrs, directed by Mike Flanagan, opens in theaters March 12, 2027. Scarlett Johansson plays Det. Julie Miller and John Leguizamo a serial killer called Father Sunday, with Chiwetel Ejiofor and Laurence Fishburne as priests. The first trailer is dated October 10.

takes.h: NECA's Ultimate Elvira opens for pre-order
takes.p: NECA's Ultimate Elvira is a 7-inch figure with a fabric dress, interchangeable hands and faceplates, Gonk, a snake, bracelets, a dagger, sunglasses, and a casserole with an attachable monster and tail, plus a stand. Pre-orders are open at the NECA Store, with shipping estimated for Q2 2027.
